title: LULLABY - Hypno Goatman Resource Pack
description: A resource pack that converts Llamii_Llama's Goatman into Lullaby, the terrifying Hypno creepypasta
body:
**A resource pack that converts Llamii_Llama's Goatman into Lullaby, the terrifying Hypno creepypasta.** Perfect for Pokémon modpacks that use Cobblemon or Pixelmon. Goatman mod (REQUIRED) - [https://modrinth.com/mod/goatman](https://modrinth.com/mod/goatman) ## Features - Adds custom model for Goatman - Adds sounds based on Hypno's cry - Adds tense chase music when Lullaby attacks SOUND WARNING - Make sure to turn entity volume down if you are sensitive to sound ![Hypno Creepypasta Goatman Dweller Minecraft Horror Creepy Spooky ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/edf7884bb60c485b0f25c7c62d867a199bf15843_0.webp)
### Check out my other related projects: Strangled Red Knocker: [Link to mod page](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/red-knocker)
HorrorMon Creepypasta forms: [Link to mod page](https://modrinth.com/datapack/horrormon-horror-forms)
